summary: Describes a methodology for benchmarking MPLS Fast Reroute link and node protection. It gives test setups and procedures for measuring failover times, taking into account factors that affect recovery for real-time traffic. It is informational.

eli5.summary: A way to time how fast traffic switches to a backup road when the main road is blocked, so you can compare different systems fairly.
